part.text:
Created a complete Maven Spring Boot project using Spring Data JPA:

```
pom.xml                                   Spring Boot 3.3.5, Java 17, data-jpa, web, validation, H2, test
src/main/java/com/example/demo/
  DemoApplication.java                    @SpringBootApplication entrypoint
  domain/Customer.java                    @Entity with auditing timestamps + bean validation
  repository/CustomerRepository.java      extends JpaRepository (derived + @Query methods)
  service/CustomerService.java            @Transactional CRUD layer
  web/CustomerController.java             REST CRUD at /api/customers
src/main/resources/application.properties H2 datasource, ddl-auto, H2 console
src/test/java/.../CustomerRepositoryTest.java  @DataJpaTest slice tests
.gitignore
```

Build/run once a JDK 17+ and Maven are available: `mvn test` and `mvn spring-boot:run` (H2 console at `/h2-console`). Note: no Java/Maven is installed in this environment, so I could not compile or run the tests here.
